```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  message = FALSE
)

library(tidyverse)
library(tidyquant)
library(zoo)
library(plotly)

background_color <- "#F4F7FB"
panel_color <- "#FFFFFF"
text_color <- "#24364B"
muted_color <- "#6B7C93"
grid_color <- "#DCE4EE"

navy <- "#173F5F"
teal <- "#2A9D8F"
orange <- "#E76F51"
purple <- "#7B61A8"
gray_soft <- "#B9C3CE"

base_layout <- function(p, main_title, subtitle) {
  p %>%
    layout(
      title = list(
        text = paste0(
          "<b>", main_title, "</b>",
          "<br>",
          "<span style='font-size:14px;color:", muted_color, ";'>",
          subtitle,
          "</span>"
        ),
        x = 0.01,
        xanchor = "left"
      ),
      paper_bgcolor = background_color,
      plot_bgcolor = panel_color,
      font = list(
        color = text_color,
        family = "Arial"
      )
    ) %>%
    config(
      displaylogo = FALSE,
      responsive = TRUE,
      modeBarButtonsToRemove = c("lasso2d", "select2d")
    )
}
```

```{r data, include=FALSE}
assets <- tibble(
  symbol = c(
    "BTC-USD",
    "ETH-USD",
    "^GSPC",
    "^IXIC",
    "GLD",
    "TLT",
    "USO",
    "UUP"
  ),
  asset = c(
    "Bitcoin",
    "Ethereum",
    "S&P 500",
    "Nasdaq",
    "Gold",
    "Long-Term Bonds",
    "Oil",
    "U.S. Dollar"
  ),
  group = c(
    "Crypto",
    "Crypto",
    "Stock market",
    "Stock market",
    "Traditional diversifier",
    "Traditional diversifier",
    "Traditional diversifier",
    "Traditional diversifier"
  )
)

price_file <- "market_prices.csv"

if (file.exists(price_file)) {
  raw_prices <- read_csv(price_file)
} else {
  raw_prices <- tq_get(
    assets$symbol,
    from = "2015-01-01",
    to = Sys.Date(),
    get = "stock.prices"
  ) %>%
    select(symbol, date, adjusted)

  write_csv(raw_prices, price_file)
}

market_prices <- raw_prices %>%
  left_join(assets, by = "symbol") %>%
  arrange(symbol, date)

market_returns <- market_prices %>%
  group_by(symbol, asset, group) %>%
  arrange(date) %>%
  mutate(log_return = log(adjusted / lag(adjusted))) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(!is.na(log_return))

sp_returns <- market_returns %>%
  filter(asset == "S&P 500") %>%
  select(date, sp_return = log_return)

comparison_assets <- assets %>%
  filter(asset != "S&P 500") %>%
  pull(asset)

calculate_correlation <- function(asset_name, window) {
  market_returns %>%
    filter(asset == asset_name) %>%
    select(date, asset_return = log_return) %>%
    inner_join(sp_returns, by = "date") %>%
    arrange(date) %>%
    mutate(
      correlation = rollapplyr(
        cbind(asset_return, sp_return),
        width = window,
        FUN = function(x) cor(x[, 1], x[, 2]),
        by.column = FALSE,
        fill = NA
      ),
      asset = asset_name,
      window = window
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(correlation))
}

bitcoin_correlation_30 <- calculate_correlation("Bitcoin", 30)
bitcoin_correlation_90 <- calculate_correlation("Bitcoin", 90)

rolling_correlation_90 <- map_dfr(
  comparison_assets,
  function(x) calculate_correlation(x, 90)
)

stress_periods <- tribble(
  ~period, ~start_date, ~end_date,
  "COVID crash", as.Date("2020-02-20"), as.Date("2020-04-30"),
  "2022 rate hikes", as.Date("2022-03-16"), as.Date("2022-10-31"),
  "FTX collapse", as.Date("2022-11-01"), as.Date("2022-12-31"),
  "April 2025 tariffs", as.Date("2025-04-01"), as.Date("2025-05-31")
)

period_levels <- c("Calm markets", stress_periods$period)

label_period <- function(one_date) {
  match_row <- stress_periods %>%
    filter(one_date >= start_date, one_date <= end_date)

  if (nrow(match_row) == 0) {
    "Calm markets"
  } else {
    match_row$period[1]
  }
}

date_labels <- rolling_correlation_90 %>%
  distinct(date) %>%
  mutate(period = map_chr(date, label_period))

event_dates <- tibble(
  event = c("COVID crash", "Rate hikes begin", "FTX collapse", "Tariffs"),
  date = as.Date(c("2020-03-16", "2022-03-16", "2022-11-08", "2025-04-02"))
)

asset_order <- c(
  "Bitcoin",
  "Ethereum",
  "Nasdaq",
  "Oil",
  "Gold",
  "Long-Term Bonds",
  "U.S. Dollar"
)
```

## Visualization 1: Bitcoin and the S&P 500 on one scale

```{r visualization-one, fig.width=15, fig.height=8}
indexed_prices <- market_prices %>%
  filter(asset %in% c("Bitcoin", "S&P 500")) %>%
  group_by(asset) %>%
  arrange(date) %>%
  mutate(growth = 100 * adjusted / first(adjusted)) %>%
  ungroup()

price_graph <- plot_ly() %>%
  add_lines(
    data = indexed_prices %>% filter(asset == "S&P 500"),
    x = ~date,
    y = ~growth,
    name = "S&P 500",
    line = list(color = teal, width = 2),
    hovertemplate = paste(
      "<b>S&P 500</b>",
      "<br>Date: %{x|%B %d, %Y}",
      "<br>Value of $100: $%{y:,.0f}",
      "<extra></extra>"
    )
  ) %>%
  add_lines(
    data = indexed_prices %>% filter(asset == "Bitcoin"),
    x = ~date,
    y = ~growth,
    name = "Bitcoin",
    line = list(color = orange, width = 2),
    hovertemplate = paste(
      "<b>Bitcoin</b>",
      "<br>Date: %{x|%B %d, %Y}",
      "<br>Value of $100: $%{y:,.0f}",
      "<extra></extra>"
    )
  ) %>%
  layout(
    yaxis = list(
      title = "Value of $100 invested (log scale)",
      type = "log",
      tickprefix = "$",
      separatethousands = TRUE,
      gridcolor = grid_color,
      zeroline = FALSE
    )
  )

correlation_graph <- plot_ly() %>%
  add_lines(
    data = bitcoin_correlation_30,
    x = ~date,
    y = ~correlation,
    name = "30-day correlation",
    line = list(color = gray_soft, width = 1),
    hovertemplate = paste(
      "<b>30-day correlation</b>",
      "<br>%{x|%B %d, %Y}: %{y:.2f}",
      "<extra></extra>"
    )
  ) %>%
  add_lines(
    data = bitcoin_correlation_90,
    x = ~date,
    y = ~correlation,
    name = "90-day correlation",
    line = list(color = navy, width = 2),
    hovertemplate = paste(
      "<b>90-day correlation</b>",
      "<br>%{x|%B %d, %Y}: %{y:.2f}",
      "<extra></extra>"
    )
  ) %>%
  add_segments(
    data = event_dates,
    x = ~date,
    xend = ~date,
    y = -1,
    yend = 1,
    line = list(color = orange, width = 1, dash = "dot"),
    showlegend = FALSE,
    hoverinfo = "text",
    text = ~event,
    inherit = FALSE
  ) %>%
  add_text(
    data = event_dates,
    x = ~date,
    y = -0.85,
    text = ~event,
    textposition = "middle right",
    textfont = list(size = 11, color = muted_color),
    showlegend = FALSE,
    hoverinfo = "skip",
    inherit = FALSE
  ) %>%
  layout(
    yaxis = list(
      title = "Correlation",
      range = c(-1, 1),
      tickvals = c(-1, -0.5, 0, 0.5, 1),
      gridcolor = grid_color,
      zeroline = TRUE,
      zerolinecolor = muted_color
    )
  )

subplot(
  price_graph,
  correlation_graph,
  nrows = 2,
  shareX = TRUE,
  heights = c(0.62, 0.38),
  titleY = TRUE,
  margin = 0.05
) %>%
  base_layout(
    "Bitcoin vs. the S&P 500",
    "Growth of $100 above; rolling correlation of daily returns below. Higher correlation means weaker diversification."
  ) %>%
  layout(
    hovermode = "x unified",
    legend = list(orientation = "h", x = 0, y = 1.08),
    xaxis = list(
      showgrid = FALSE,
      rangeselector = list(
        x = 1,
        xanchor = "right",
        y = 1.12,
        bgcolor = "#EAF0F6",
        activecolor = teal,
        bordercolor = grid_color,
        borderwidth = 1,
        buttons = list(
          list(count = 1, label = "1Y", step = "year", stepmode = "backward"),
          list(count = 3, label = "3Y", step = "year", stepmode = "backward"),
          list(count = 5, label = "5Y", step = "year", stepmode = "backward"),
          list(step = "all", label = "All")
        )
      )
    ),
    xaxis2 = list(title = "Date", showgrid = FALSE),
    margin = list(l = 95, r = 60, t = 135, b = 70)
  )
```

## Visualization 2: Correlation heatmap across every asset

```{r visualization-two, fig.width=15, fig.height=6}
heatmap_data <- rolling_correlation_90 %>%
  mutate(month = floor_date(date, "month")) %>%
  group_by(asset, month) %>%
  summarise(correlation = mean(correlation), .groups = "drop")

heatmap_table <- heatmap_data %>%
  mutate(month = as.character(month)) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = month, values_from = correlation) %>%
  arrange(match(asset, asset_order))

heatmap_dates <- as.Date(names(heatmap_table)[-1])
heatmap_assets <- heatmap_table$asset
heatmap_values <- as.matrix(heatmap_table[, -1])

plot_ly(
  x = heatmap_dates,
  y = heatmap_assets,
  z = heatmap_values,
  type = "heatmap",
  zmin = -1,
  zmax = 1,
  colorscale = list(
    list(0, "#3B4CC0"),
    list(0.5, "#F7F9FC"),
    list(1, orange)
  ),
  colorbar = list(
    title = list(text = "Correlation<br>with S&P 500"),
    tickvals = c(-1, -0.5, 0, 0.5, 1)
  ),
  hovertemplate = paste(
    "<b>%{y}</b>",
    "<br>Month: %{x|%B %Y}",
    "<br>Correlation: %{z:.2f}",
    "<extra></extra>"
  )
) %>%
  base_layout(
    "Correlation with the S&P 500 over time",
    "Each column is one month. Warm = moves with stocks (weak diversifier), cool = moves against stocks."
  ) %>%
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Month", showgrid = FALSE),
    yaxis = list(title = "", automargin = TRUE),
    annotations = list(
      list(
        text = paste(
          "White gap before 2018 = Ethereum had not launched yet, not missing data.",
          "Nasdaq is included as a reference for what no diversification looks like."
        ),
        x = 0,
        y = -0.22,
        xref = "paper",
        yref = "paper",
        showarrow = FALSE,
        xanchor = "left",
        font = list(size = 12, color = muted_color)
      )
    ),
    margin = list(l = 140, r = 90, t = 100, b = 90)
  )
```

## Visualization 3: Does diversification hold up during market stress?

```{r visualization-three, fig.width=15, fig.height=7}
stress_summary <- rolling_correlation_90 %>%
  left_join(date_labels, by = "date") %>%
  group_by(period, asset) %>%
  summarise(average_correlation = mean(correlation), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(
    period = factor(period, levels = period_levels),
    asset = factor(asset, levels = asset_order)
  )

plot_ly(
  data = stress_summary,
  x = ~asset,
  y = ~average_correlation,
  color = ~period,
  colors = c(gray_soft, navy, teal, orange, purple),
  type = "bar",
  hovertemplate = paste(
    "<b>%{x}</b>",
    "<br>Period: %{fullData.name}",
    "<br>Average correlation: %{y:.2f}",
    "<extra></extra>"
  )
) %>%
  base_layout(
    "Does diversification weaken when markets are under stress?",
    "Average 90-day correlation with the S&P 500. Gray bar is the calm-market baseline for comparison."
  ) %>%
  layout(
    barmode = "group",
    legend = list(orientation = "h", x = 0, y = 1.1),
    xaxis = list(title = "", tickangle = -20),
    yaxis = list(
      title = "Average correlation",
      range = c(-1, 1),
      tickvals = c(-1, -0.5, 0, 0.5, 1),
      gridcolor = grid_color,
      zeroline = TRUE,
      zerolinecolor = muted_color
    ),
    margin = list(l = 80, r = 50, t = 130, b = 110)
  )
```

## Visualization 4: Risk versus diversification

```{r visualization-four, fig.width=13, fig.height=7}
volatility_summary <- market_returns %>%
  filter(asset %in% comparison_assets) %>%
  semi_join(sp_returns, by = "date") %>%
  group_by(asset, group) %>%
  summarise(
    annualized_volatility = sd(log_return) * sqrt(252) * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

correlation_summary <- rolling_correlation_90 %>%
  group_by(asset) %>%
  summarise(average_correlation = mean(correlation), .groups = "drop")

risk_summary <- correlation_summary %>%
  left_join(volatility_summary, by = "asset")

plot_ly(
  data = risk_summary,
  x = ~average_correlation,
  y = ~annualized_volatility,
  color = ~group,
  colors = c(
    "Crypto" = orange,
    "Stock market" = navy,
    "Traditional diversifier" = teal
  ),
  text = ~asset,
  type = "scatter",
  mode = "markers+text",
  textposition = "top center",
  textfont = list(size = 12, color = text_color),
  marker = list(size = 15, line = list(color = "#FFFFFF", width = 1.5)),
  hovertemplate = paste(
    "<b>%{text}</b>",
    "<br>Average correlation: %{x:.2f}",
    "<br>Annualized volatility: %{y:.1f}%",
    "<extra></extra>"
  )
) %>%
  base_layout(
    "Risk versus diversification",
    "Bottom-left is the ideal corner: low correlation with stocks and low volatility."
  ) %>%
  layout(
    legend = list(orientation = "h", x = 0, y = 1.1),
    xaxis = list(
      title = "Average 90-day correlation with the S&P 500 (left = better diversifier)",
      range = c(-1, 1),
      gridcolor = grid_color,
      zeroline = TRUE,
      zerolinecolor = muted_color
    ),
    yaxis = list(
      title = "Annualized volatility, % (higher = riskier)",
      rangemode = "tozero",
      gridcolor = grid_color
    ),
    margin = list(l = 90, r = 60, t = 120, b = 90)
  )
```



```{r numbers-for-writeup, include=FALSE}
stress_summary %>%
  filter(asset %in% c("Bitcoin", "Ethereum", "Gold", "Long-Term Bonds")) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = period, values_from = average_correlation)

risk_summary %>%
  arrange(desc(annualized_volatility))

rolling_correlation_90 %>%
  mutate(era = if_else(date < as.Date("2020-01-01"), "Before 2020", "2020 onward")) %>%
  group_by(asset, era) %>%
  summarise(average_correlation = mean(correlation), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = era, values_from = average_correlation)
```
